feasibleAlternatives.label: Shade living room

feasibleAlternatives.implication: Reducing solar gain helps manage room temperature drift, although it does not stop the degradation.

feasibleAlternatives.label: Shade bedrooms

feasibleAlternatives.implication: Reducing solar gain in occupied rooms prioritizes the comfort of those inside.

feasibleAlternatives.implication: The backup battery (bk-station) may not connect to the concentrator; verifying this connection is critical for continuity.
